pagure_name.description: The name of the Pagure instance this CI service is integrated with.

db_url.description: Database connection string for Pagure-CI's internal data (e.g., build history).

git_clone_dir.description: Path to directory where source repositories will be cloned during CI builds.

artifact_dir.description: Path to directory where build logs, test results, and other artifacts will be stored.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

debug.description: Enable development/debug mode (includes stack traces in UI and verbose logging).

num_workers.description: Number of parallel worker processes to run build tasks.

max_concurrent_builds.description: Maximum number of builds allowed to run concurrently per project.

build_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) a build may run before being terminated.

smtp_enabled.description: Enable sending email notifications on build failures or successes.

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname to use for sending emails.

smtp_username.description: SMTP username (only if server requires authentication).

smtp_password.description: SMTP password (only if server requires authentication).

smtp_from_addr.description: Email address shown as sender in CI notifications.

webhook_enabled.description: Enable webhook support for external systems (e.g., GitHub/GitLab triggers).

webhook_secret_token.description: Shared secret used to validate authenticity of incoming webhook requests.

github_enabled.description: Enable GitHub integration to post commit statuses and trigger builds on PR/push events.

github_api_url.description: Base URL for GitHub API (e.g., https://api.github.com or https://github.example.com/api/v3 for GHE).

gitlab_enabled.description: Enable GitLab integration to post commit statuses and trigger builds on MR/push events.

gitlab_api_url.description: Base URL for GitLab API (e.g., https://gitlab.com/api/v4 or custom instance).

builders.description: List of build environments (builders) to use for testing projects.

name.description: Unique identifier for the builder (used in project config).

image.description: Docker image to use for building (only for 'docker' type).

docker_extra_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to 'docker run' (e.g., '--network=host').

python_version.description: Python version to use for virtualenv builder (only for 'virtualenv' type).

setup_commands.description: List of shell commands to run before each build (e.g., installing dependencies).

redis_url.description: Redis connection URL used for task queue (Celery backend).

cors_allowed_origins.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS requests (e.g., your Pagure frontend).
